description: Load and inspect a CSV dataset
input: Analyze this CSV — what patterns do you see in sales.csv?
expect: Agent loads the CSV into a DataFrame, checks encoding/delimiter, and reports shape, dtypes, and summary statistics before deeper analysis.
assertions: dataset is loaded with pd.read_csv and inspected with info()/describe()
shape, columns, dtypes, and numeric summary are reported

input: Plot revenue over time and show me the trend.
expect: Agent sets a datetime index, resamples as needed, and produces a line/area chart with labeled axes, title, and data source footnote.
assertions: date column is parsed with pd.to_datetime and set as index
a line or area chart is produced for time x numeric
axes are labeled and chart has a title

description: Clean a messy dataset without mutating source
input: Clean this messy dataset — fix missing values and deduplicate.
expect: Agent works on df_clean = df.copy(), reports each change (duplicates dropped, imputation used), and never modifies the source file without permission.
assertions: work happens on a copy, not the original
each cleaning action is reported with counts
irreversible decisions are surfaced before acting

description: Statistical hypothesis test with honest reporting
input: Run a t-test on group A vs B to see if the means differ.
expect: Agent runs an independent t-test (checking assumptions), and reports test statistic, p-value, and effect size rather than just significant/not.
assertions: ttest_ind or Mann-Whitney U is used per assumptions
p-value and effect size are reported
sample size caveats are mentioned when relevant

description: Near-miss negative: database schema design without data
input: What columns should my users table have?
expect: Schema design without actual data is an explicit near-miss negative for this skill.
assertions: skill does not trigger on schema design questions

description: Near-miss negative: statistics theory without a dataset
expect: General statistics theory without a dataset context is a documented near-miss negative.
assertions: skill does not trigger on pure theory questions

input: Design a data ingestion pipeline for our warehouse.
expect: ETL pipeline architecture is a documented near-miss negative — routes to data engineering skills instead.
assertions: skill does not trigger on pipeline architecture requests
